messages:
erin.m: Hi all
just started today! Two quick things: 1) I need access to the private model test env and a small GPU quota for a PoC. 2) Who should I study to understand "who owns what" for customer escalations and infra ownership? Looking for a short map or who-to-cc list.

tom.c: Welcome, erin! For env + quota open a request in #eng-infra or use the infra portal: https://go/redwood/infra-requests. Tag it with 'new-hire-qa' and @nate.infra will triage.

priya.hr: Hi erin, congrats and welcome :) For HR/payroll/hardware reach out to me directly. I'll also send the security/compliance checklist you need to complete in the next 48h.

onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: tasks assigned to erin.m: (1) Complete security training (2) Fill laptop/hardware form (3) Join #product-oncall channel. Due in 3 days.

erin.m: Thanks! For the ownership map, is there a short list I can bookmark? Curious who owns: data plane, model serving, routing/fallback policies, and customer incident liaison.

steph.s: We keep a lightweight owners table in the runbook: https://go/redwood/owners-table. Short answers: data plane = eng-storage, model serving = eng-runtime, routing/policies = eng-platform, customer incident liaison = customer-ops (and SRE for infra-level).

tom.c: Quick escalation ladder: first: oncall -> second: team lead of owning service -> third: platform/SRE -> fourth: CTO-on-duty (only for P0s). For cross-team disagreements, CC the EMs and put a postmortem if it affected customer-facing SLAs.

erin.m: Nice. Who signs off on Dedicated capacity trial budgets? I might need ~4 hours of a 4-GPU box for a test tomorrow.

nate.infra: For ad-hoc trials <24h, eng-platform can approve. Submit a short request in the infra portal with cost center and duration; include manager approver. If you need recurring reserved capacity, that goes through finance and product infra and takes longer.

steph.s: If you're shadowing incidents next week, ask to be added to the incident run-through doc. Also read the SLOs chapter in the runbook so you know escalation criteria.

erin.m: Where do I find the contact emails or rotation list for pager escalation? Want to avoid paging the wrong person during shadowing.

tom.c: Pager rotation is in the oncall schedule: https://go/redwood/oncall-schedule. Pages go to the oncall pager; if no ack in 5 minutes, the next person is paged automatically. If it's customer-impacting, also notify customer-ops via #support-urgent.

priya.hr: FYI onboarding orientation is at 9:30 tomorrow. I'll add a quick intro to teams and owners so new hires know who to reach for common lanes.

erin.m: Awesome, appreciate the clarity. One last question: who owns the access review for external contractors?

steph.s: Access reviews are owned by security with team-level approvers. For contractors working on models, get approval from eng-runtime lead + security. There's a one-page form: https://go/redwood/ext-access.

erin.m: Great, thanks everyone! I'll fill the infra request now and post the ticket number here.

onboarding-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-5991 by erin.m (new-hire env request)  assigned to nate.infra. ETA 8 business hours.
